note: Regional park on the shores of Nickle Lake and the Souris River near Weyburn, where tall poplars line the road in and each area has a playground; there are shelters and benches along the shoreline, a groomed sandy beach and roped-off swimming area (no lifeguard), an 18-hole mini golf course and a canteen.  Mostly seasonal: about 70 of its 342 sites are sold by the night (River View, Circle Drive, Dorsch Bay and a few at Crescent Point); seasonal sites are long-term leases.  Two boat launches and a floating dock serve the lake, which holds walleye, perch and pike and has a fish-cleaning area.  An 18-hole golf course is 3 miles away. --Claude
